title: Graduate Software Engineer
jd:
About the Company Grapple is a fast-growing technology company based in Bristol, building innovative software solutions that help businesses streamline their operations. With a collaborative culture and a strong focus on continuous learning, Grapple invests heavily in developing early-career talent and empowering its engineers to grow into future technical leaders.
About the Role We're looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Bristol. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to kick-start their career in software development, working alongside experienced engineers on real-world products used by thousands of customers. You'll receive structured mentorship and hands-on training as you build your technical skills.
Key Responsibilities Write clean, maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and contribute to the design and implementation of new features. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including product and design, help troubleshoot and resolve bugs, and gradually take on greater ownership of projects as your confidence and skills develop.
Requirements A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is required. No prior professional experience is necessary, though personal projects, internships, or coursework demonstrating programming ability are a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, eagerness to learn, and good communication skills are essential.
Benefits Grapple offers a salary of £30,000-35,000, along with a dedicated graduate onboarding programme, mentorship from senior engineers, and clear pathways for career progression. Additional benefits include private health insurance, 25 days annual leave, flexible working arrangements, and regular team socials.
